remarks: Spacious 2-3BR, 2.5BA colonial rental in Glenbrook with an open layout and hardwood floors throughout. Large kitchen with stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop, ample cabinetry, and breakfast bar. Flexible space includes a partially finished walk-out basement-ideal for a home office, gym, or extra living area-plus attic storage. Enjoy a private rear deck and backyard, along with plenty of off-street parking. Natural gas heat and cooking. One dog or cat allowed. Quiet dead-end street just minutes to the Glenbrook train station, shopping, public transportation, and major highways-perfect for easy commuting. Home available fully or partially furnished.
